findings.ref: human-copy/README.md: What's staged / Human-apply command sequence
findings.note: The checked-in staging tree contains README.md and .github/workflows/test.yml, but the runner excludes only MANIFEST.sha256 and apply-protected-files.ps1 from its recursive payload set. Consequently, invoking the runner against the repository as staged fails exact-set validation unless a human first deletes versioned staging files, so the delivered batch is not directly applicable and AC-031 is not operationally complete.

findings.ref: tasks.md: Protected Files item 3; human-copy/README.md: Why .github/workflows/test.yml is NOT in MANIFEST.sha256
findings.note: The approved task contract says apply-protected-files.ps1 applies the staged .github/workflows/test.yml candidate alongside the four payload files, while the implementation deliberately limits the runner and manifest to four targets and instructs a plain cp for test.yml. This unresolved contract divergence bypasses the required hash and post-copy verification for the protected CI workflow candidate.
